QuestInfo.name: [Kerning Tower] Kerning Tower Grand Opening
QuestInfo.0: A letter arrived from #p1052006# in Kerning Subway. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: You heard that a high-rise shopping center was built where Kerning Square used to be. It's called Kerning Tower! #p1052006# is happy that the old subway route is up and running again, but he seems a little worried. Go find #b#p1052006##k in #r#m103020000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p1052006# is a bit sad that his old friend and one-time star, #p1052203#, has fallen on hard times. A few days ago, he confined himself to his room. Go to #r#m103041001##k in #p1052006#'s place.

0.0: - To #b#h0##k\r\nHey! It's #p1052006# from the subway. Did you hear? There's a new high-rise shopping center where Kerning Square used to be. It's called Kerning Tower. Pretty cool name, if you ask me!
0.1: #p1052115# is happy that the Kerning Subway is good and busy again. It's just #p1052203#...
0.2: ...Ah, forget it. Anyway, why don't you go check it out? It IS the hottest new place around, after all!
0.3: Come look for me at #r#m103020000##k, and I'll help you get to Kerning Tower!\r\n- From Jake\r\n #r* When you accept, you will move immediately to #m103020000# where Jake is.#k

1.0: Good to see you here, #b#h0##k! #rThe train to Kerning Tower is just past the ticket gate#k.

yes.0: I'm happy to see so many people taking the subway again, but one thing troubles me. My old friend #p1052203# has confined himself to his office at Kerning Tower. I don't know what's wrong with him.
yes.1: Once upon a time, he was quite famous. Lately he just hasn't been himself. He should be at #r#m103041001# in the basement of Kerning Tower#k. I'd check on him, but I'm on duty.
yes.2: When you arrive at Kerning Tower, could you check up on #p1052203# for me? It would mean a lot to me...

default.0: Come look for me at #r#m103020000##k, and I'll help you get to Kerning Tower! I'll be waiting for you by the ticket gate where I'm always at!\r\n\r\n　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　- From Jake
